mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, bool_status_enum, category, name, serial_number,brand, plate, color, material, coating, plating, weight, thickness, width,unfolded_width,length, quantity, total_length, total_area, drawing_number,remark, business_id,attachment_id,bend_times,area_type,user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT pro.id 'project.id', pro.`name` 'project.name', pro.short_name 'project.shortName', pro.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', SUM( enc.quantity ) 'totalQuantity', SUM( enc.produced_quantity ) 'totalCompleteQuantity' FROM tech_enclosure enc LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON enc.project_id=pro.id WHERE enc.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND enc.project_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY project_id

SELECT enc.*, pro.id 'project.id', pro.`name` 'project.name', pro.short_name 'project.shortName', pro.serial_number 'shortName.serialNumber', plan.id 'plan.id', plan.`name`'plan.name', plan.quantity_work 'plan.quantityWork', plan.date 'plan.date', us.`name` 'userName' FROM tech_enclosure enc LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON enc.project_id = pro.id LEFT JOIN enclosure_plan plan ON enc.enclosure_plan_id = plan.id LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON enc.user_id = us.id WHERE enc.bool_delete_enum = 0
and enc.category & #{category}>1
and enc.produced_quantity =0
and enc.produced_quantity >0 and enc.quantity>enc.produced_quantity
and enc.quantity=enc.produced_quantity
AND enc.enclosure_plan_id IN
#{item}

SELECT enc.*, pro.id 'project.id', pro.`name` 'project.name', pro.short_name 'project.shortName', pro.serial_number 'shortName.serialNumber', mon.id 'monomer.id', mon.`name` 'monomer.name', area.id 'area.id', area.`name`'area.name', us.`name` 'userName' FROM tech_enclosure enc LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON enc.project_id = pro.id LEFT join plan_monomer mon on enc.monomer_id = mon.id left join plan_area area on enc.area_id = area.id LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON enc.user_id = us.id WHERE enc.bool_delete_enum = 0
and enc.dictionary_id = #{dictionaryId}
and enc.produced_quantity =0
and enc.produced_quantity >0 and enc.quantity > enc.produced_quantity
and enc.quantity=enc.produced_quantity
AND enc.area_id IN
#{item}

select enclo.id, task.id 'taskId', orde.id 'taskOrderId', enclo.bool_status_enum from mes_enclosure_task_order orde left join mes_enclosure_task task on task.task_order_id = orde.id left join tech_enclosure enclo on task.product_id = enclo.id and task.dictionary_id = enclo.dictionary_id
task.bool_delete_enum = 0 and enclo.bool_delete_enum = 0
and orde.id in
#{orderId}
order by enclo.id ASC
